column1: # TEMPLATE -- qmd-checks. Copied into a project by install.sh only when the
# project has no number_consistency_ignore.tsv of its own. It ships with the
# header row and no rulings; every suppression below the header should be one
# Adjudicated-as-fine precision differences, read by check_number_consistency.R.
# A quantity shown at two precisions is usually drift, but not always: an
# equation may carry more decimals than the sentence that paraphrases it, on
# purpose. Once a pair has been ruled on, record it here and it stays quiet.
# The file also silences RECONSTRUCTIBLE FIGURE VALUE findings, which flag a
# risk rather than a proven mismatch: the checker reads source and never
# evaluates, so it cannot tell whether the arithmetic closes at the displayed
# precision. Suppress one only after checking the rendered numbers, and say in
# the note what they were -- if the data behind them is ever refreshed, that
# record is the only way to know the closure still holds.
